exercises.title: Open record and Tweak 'A record opens' are two layouts of one machine
exercises.detail: ListScreen derives split/compact from route child, viewport and the openIn tweak; no single state value exists.
exercises.fix: Keep the derivation in one computed (stacked/split) as now; tests should assert on it.

approvals.title: Approve and Reject have no distinct in-flight state per button
approvals.detail: `acting` disables Reject while Approve loads but a second action can follow a failure with stale doc.
approvals.fix: Clear `doc` and refetch after a failed action.

approvals.title: Selected request can outlive its queue row
approvals.detail: After queue.reload the selected row may no longer exist while the pane stays open.
approvals.fix: Close the pane when the selected row is absent from the refreshed list.
